label: V1c — ribbon and traditional measurements
reference_roles: V1b complete base and wood-background composition
Clean restored 6-2 ribbon and measurement sticker only
prompt:
Edit IMAGE 1, the photographic-vegetable cover with continuous pale scrubbed-wood background. IMAGE 2 is ONLY the reference for two graphics to transfer: its red corner ribbon and small black/gold measurement sticker. Do not copy image 2's illustrated vegetables, cream background, title arrangement, subtitle or YouTube sticker placement.
Make exactly these three changes to image 1:
1. Remove ONLY the standalone bright green TWO-LEAF LOGO above the middle of the word "Vegetable", near the little word "The". Replace its entire shape and stem with a seamless continuation of the pale scrubbed-wood background. Leave the word "The" and every title letter in their existing positions and sizes; leave open wood space where the logo was. Keep ALL real vegetable foliage, tomato leaves, pea tendril and carrot fronds intact.
2. Transfer the red diagonal "100% Organic" ribbon from image 2 to the TOP LEFT corner of image 1, at the same relative size and angle. Match its narrow red band, white lettering, slight underside shadow, and edge-to-edge wrap across the corner. The ribbon goes visibly ON TOP of the photographic vegetable foliage. Keep the exact mixed-case text "100% Organic", sharply legible, running along the ribbon. On a 1100 x 1430 canvas its corner diagonal extends about 255 pixels along the top and 240 pixels down the left edge, matching image 2. It must not reach or obscure the book title.
3. Transfer the SAME small ROUND BLACK AND GOLD "TRADITIONAL MEASUREMENTS" sticker from image 2 into the lower-left area of image 1. Match the black face, fine double gold circular rim, curved gold TRADITIONAL at top, curved gold MEASUREMENTS at bottom, and gold outline of a traditional scale weight in the middle, with exact unit lettering "lb · oz" on its first line and "ft · in" on its second line. Same size and location as in image 2: circle about 195 pixels diameter, centre approximately x=182, y=1293 on a 1100 x 1430 canvas; leave a comfortable gap from the left and bottom edges. It sits on top of the carrots with a modest soft contact shadow. Keep its slight hand-applied angle from the reference, its crisp edge and legible gold text. This measurement sticker must be clearly smaller than the existing YouTube sticker.
Preserve every other part of IMAGE 1 as faithfully as possible: photorealistic vegetables and their arrangement, natural foliage overlaps, continuous pale sage/ivory whitewashed wood grain, large centred dark-green "The Vegetable Guru", the smaller centred two-line "Your at-a-glance" / "growing companion", "John Lennon", and the existing small white tilted YouTube sticker at LOWER RIGHT with all its exact content. No additional words, badges, leaf icons, borders or redesign. Do not alter the main title layout, letter shapes or subtitle spacing. Retain foreground detail and avoid grain, cloudy mottling or sharpening artefacts. Full-bleed flat portrait cover in the same 185:240 proportions, no mockup.
